items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK, Beispielweg 1, 34117 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated 12.03.2026 (Thursday). For social-insurance letters sent by ordinary post, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X deems delivery on the 4th day after posting, i.e. 16.03.2026 (Monday) — this coincides with the 'Bescheid vom 16.03.2026' mentioned in the body text, so the two dates in the letter are consistent once the deemed-delivery rule is applied. Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (16.03.) is not counted; the one-month period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) runs from 17.03.2026 and ends on the day in the following month with the same number, i.e. 16.04.2026 (Thursday, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 16.04.2026 is a normal working day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. Deadline: 16.04.2026.

warnings: The letterhead is dated 12.03.2026 but the letter's own text refers to 'Bescheid vom 16.03.2026' — a later date than the letter itself; this is an internal inconsistency, though it happens to match the statutory 4-day deemed-delivery date, so it does not change the computed Widerspruch deadline of 16.04.2026.

The letter rejects household help (Haushaltshilfe) entirely because no child under 12 lives in the household and the statutes (Satzung) provide no extended benefit — check the insurer's Satzung yourself in case broader entitlements exist that were overlooked.
